persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy.
bank.Mark and style: A simple green sprout above the name; clean and unfussy.

messages.text: Could you make a logo for my plant shop? I've been thinking about this little shop a lot, so getting a logo made feels like an exciting step. The shop is called Little Sprout, and I want the logo to be square. For the design, just put a simple green sprout above the name on a white background, nothing fancy. I'm probably over-explaining because the whole thing means a lot to me.
